notes: v1.1.122 (bug-report pass): (1) Updates no longer fail on a slow close: the installer waits until the app and anything it started have really exited (up to 90 s) instead of 3 s - the 1.1.120 update failed on a server PC with files in use. (2) The app closes at once (was up to 48 s of 'Not Responding' while Tk tore down the big tables). (3) The account tables no longer redraw every 5 s while an account runs - the main cause of the 7-23 s UI freezes on 24/7 PCs. (4) Facebook's own redirect during a page load (to a checkpoint, to web.facebook.com) no longer fails a 956 Check or a browser open. (5) Phone (ADB) Hotmail codes wait the 90 s Outlook needs (gave up at 32 s). An account already sent for review is reported as such. (6) Bug reports: programming errors in 53 more places, JavaScript errors inside pages, one issue per bug (not one per page name / URL), rare warnings sooner, and normal account states (logged out, walls, wrong password, captcha shown) no longer bury real bugs. Carries 1.1.121: m-mode saved login kept, code steps answered in every task, browser location + check-in, captcha without time waste.
